prompts.about: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide office photograph background banner for a boutique healthcare communications agency website. Generate one image, landscape 1536x1024 or wider. Natural editorial architectural photography, bright soft daylight, warm pale wood, glass partitions, off-white walls, restrained navy details, green plants, realistic textures. A calm uncluttered left half must allow a left-aligned page title; important subject and activity on the right half, middle vertical third, to allow a shallow wide desktop hero crop.
